item.title: Paintbox Collection 2 (Universal) 2.0
item.description:
• Paintbox Collection 2 — a new app: Digital Fine Art (DFA-7000), the Classic Paintbox (DPB 7000/1) and the Paintbox V-Series, chosen from one loading screen.
  • New logos and welcome screens; each Paintbox opens on its welcome screen.
  • The V-series chalk in every machine, the DFA included; the DFA cursor throughout.
  • Paste-up: the direction pad comes up in the number pad's place; the position boxes drag and take typed values.
  • Graphics: lines menu with stick, connected, h v only and radial; graduated rectangles with clear arrows; colour fettle DOIT.
